banner: Kenya's Ministry of Health says this is a single imported case under management, not a local outbreak. As of 7 Oct, UN/WHO reporting said no other infections had been identified.
regional: DRC: confirmed cases reported above 8,300 and deaths above 4,000 across seven provinces.
Uganda: 20 cases and 2 deaths earlier this year; declared Ebola-free in August.
Kenya is the fourth country to confirm a Bundibugyo case in this outbreak (WHO).
WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions on Kenya, DRC and Uganda.

events.title: UN / KENYA DRC EBOLA UPDATE - UN Media
US issues ebola alert to American in Kenya - The Star, Kenya
events.text: US issues ebola alert to American in Kenya

events.title: 57 contacts listed, 10 quarantined
events.text: MoH says contact tracing continues and numbers will rise. Quarantined contacts are held at the National Police Service Hospital. The Ministry stresses this is an imported case, not an outbreak.

events.title: Kenya confirms first Ebola case (Bundibugyo)
events.text: Health CS Aden Duale announces the first confirmed case: a Kenyan who had lived in DRC for years, died at Nairobi Hospital. Confirmed by the National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI.

events.title: Patient's journey into Kenya
events.text: Per WHO: road from DRC via Beni to Kampala on 2 Oct, Jambojet flight to Nairobi on 3 Oct, passed airport screening, isolated at Nairobi Hospital.

events.title: Uganda declared Ebola-free
events.text: Uganda ends its outbreak after 20 cases and 2 deaths.

events.title: Reported Turkish national case ruled out
events.text: PS Mary Muthoni says testing showed the patient was negative, dismissing social-media reports.

events.title: 16 suspected cases tested, all negative
events.text: CS Duale says people who had travelled from DRC or Uganda were tested and monitored.

events.title: MoH issues first advisory
events.text: After the outbreak is confirmed in Ituri, DRC, the Ministry reports no cases in Kenya and activates preparedness measures. WHO declares a global health emergency the same day.

ituri.t: Outbreak declared here. The DRC has since reported 8,300+ confirmed cases across seven provinces.
ituri.cap: The outbreak was declared in Ituri, DRC in May 2026.

beni.t: Per WHO, the patient travelled by road through Beni towards Uganda after about a month of illness.
beni.cap: 2 Oct: the patient travels by road from DRC (via Beni) towards Kampala.

kampala.t: Reached Kampala 2 Oct, flew Jambojet to Nairobi 3 Oct. MoH says he had a normal temperature at Entebbe screening.
kampala.cap: 3 Oct: he flies from Kampala/Entebbe to Nairobi.

nairobi.t: Landed at JKIA, taken to Nairobi Hospital, isolated. Confirmed 6 Oct; patient died. 57 contacts listed, 10 quarantined (7 Oct).
nairobi.cap: 6 Oct: Kenya confirms Bundibugyo virus. First case; patient has died.

eldoret.t: 50 isolation beds (MoH, 7 Oct). No cases reported here.
eldoret.cap: Isolation and testing sites are on alert. No other cases reported.

mombasa.t: 4 isolation beds (MoH, 7 Oct). No cases reported here.

kisumu.t: A national Ebola testing site named by MoH. No cases reported here.
